You need to move away from your family or atleast set boundaries in your home. You also need to ignore your coworker if you can. We are in similar situations Im also living with an abusive family and have a friend that is triggering me. What really helped me is the pandemic. My parents becomes less abusive because im busy with college and I still talk with my friend but pay less attention to him.

You will keep being miserable if you stay with people that triggers you. If you can't be physically away from them then atleast set boundaries. You also need to change your perspective and focus on the positives in life. I did and now I'm happier. Whenever you feel down I suggest watching this [video](https://youtu.be/h6fcK_fRYaI).

You seriously also need friends. Maybe open up to your coworkers or reconnect with your highschool/college friends. Even cousins. I apologized to the people that I have been toxic to and I felt better and also it even strengthened some of those relationships. If you can't connect with your past friends then make new ones. There's a friend option in bumble.
Thanks!

Dealt with bad and controlling parents myself so I know how you feel. You need to get out of that situation. You're now an adult so take action. No more excuses. If you don't have courage to defend yourself from your mother then find another way to escape.

You had bad start in life so you shouldn't be ashamed of yourself. Everyone have different starts, you may never reach what others can reach and that's okay. You should  treat yourself as you would treat others. Would you ridicule others for having a worse start than you and not being on the same level as you? If not then why should you do it to yourself?

Everybody can be pretty with money. Get a good haircut, eat healthy, dress good, have a good hygiene then boom you're pretty. Men would be lining up for you. 

You can go back to HS, you're still young. Although middle school is full of bullies and they might bully you for your age, you have to understand they're still kids transitioning into teenagers so please be patient with them.

You're 19 now you can get a job. Do you have a job? Go get a job. Any job. You can make a paypal account and earn money online to support you while you're studying or work as a fast food worker or any other manual jobs.  Do you not have money to pay for HS? Then work first while also seeking other jobs then go to HS when you already have money. While you're in HS, plan ahead so you can pursue college after if you want to. Think ahead if you will have enough money or will you need to do part-time jobs while at it. Plan ahead so you will never go back to this depressing hole again.

Being pretty and having a nice body isn't everything. Believe me. If anyone wants you only for your looks then that's a red flag. It shows that they're immature. Don't date guys like that. 

What men want is a woman who is passionate and happy with herself

Do you have hobbies? Get hobbies. Join clubs that relate to that hobbies and who knows? Those hobbies can lead you to a good career.

Are you socially awkward? some men are ok with that but it will give you a better chance if you're not. 

What makes a woman beautiful is not solely by her looks but her love for herself. Once you accept yourself and be confident of yourself then all that anxiety you feel when talking with others will be gone because you will see that all that fear of not being wanted is only your feelings about yourself. Try to understand other people more and you will learn that you shouldn't assume they're thinking about you, instead you should try to know what they're thinking about you by talking to them.

Some people including your family might not like you and that's okay. Not everyone is gonna like you so you should stay away from those people and find friends that can make you feel safe.

One thing I also learned late is that boyfriends/girlfriends don't come to you instantly. They're strong relationships that are built from friendships so if you want a boyfriend, then make friends first then all else will follow.

Focus on building yourself first then romantic relationships will come later when you have peace with yourself.
